artisansTeaser.title: MEET THE HANDS BEHIND EVERY WEAVE.
artisansTeaser.description: Every VAKAA piece is born in female-led artisan cooperatives across Ghana and West Africa. Master weavers preserve ancestral raffia techniques passed down through generations, earning sustainable living wages that transform local communities.

testimonials.title: WORDS FROM THE TRIBE
testimonials.subtitle: Trusted and cherished by luxury collectors across 40+ countries worldwide.
testimonials.quote1: The craftsmanship on the Maa Tote is extraordinary. The raffia weave is tight and tactile, and the leather handles feel indestructible. It gets compliments wherever I travel.
testimonials.quote2: VAKAA represents everything luxury should be — cultural authenticity, zero compromise on quality, and true artisan empowerment. The Kemi bag is my daily staple.
testimonials.quote3: Arrived in beautiful packaging with an artisan authenticity card. The Zuri Clutch is stunning in person; the brass clasp and rich gold tones elevate any evening look.
